subject: Observify telemetry hook: urgent subprocessor addition & EU export clarification
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@observify.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Observify Security <security@observify.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T08:12:00Z
Subject: Quick: adding a telemetry hook (temporary) - need DPA/subprocessor note

Hi Marissa,

We're rolling a small telemetry hook for an on‑prem customer demo that's scheduled for EMEA next week. The change is limited — an Observify edge agent will forward anonymized metrics and service-level logs to our processing cluster for 72 hours so we can validate the new metrics dashboard.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood accept Observify as a temporary subprocessor for telemetry (we'll be listed as a subprocessor under Observify's DPA with you)?
- We may route the short-lived stream via our US telemetry ingestion endpoint — can you confirm whether that triggers any additional approvals or export-control checks on your side?

I've attached a short deck and a one‑row roster export with the new agent listed. Apologies for the short notice — demo got moved up. If needed we can gate the stream to onshore nodes only, but that will delay the rollout.

Attachments: observify_subprocessor_deck.pdf, subprocessor_roster_v1.csv

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Partnerships / Observability

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@observify.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: adding a telemetry hook (temporary) - need DPA/subprocessor note

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the materials.

Quick reply while I loop in compliance: I don't have the authority to approve new subprocessors myself. Tagging Kimberly and Irene from Legal/Privacy — can you help with the following before we consider authorizing a temporary onramp?

1) A minimal dataflow diagram showing which fields are being forwarded (metrics only vs any PII/identifiers).
2) SOC 2 / ISO attestation for the specific ingestion cluster (not just company-level PDF).
3) Confirmation whether the stream will contain client-provided identifiers (customer_id, user_id, session_id) or only aggregated counts.

If we can get those within the day we can try to expedite an emergency exception for a 72‑hour window. Otherwise we will need to pin the agent to EU-only endpoints which will add ~24h to the schedule.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@observify.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-12-01T11:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: adding a telemetry hook (temporary) - need DPA/subprocessor note

On Fri, Dec 1, 2028 at 09:02, marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the heads up and the materials.

Alex — thanks for flagging. A few compliance/legal items and process notes:

- Temporary subprocessor acceptance: We can consider a time‑boxed exception but need explicit "scoped subprocessor" language and an accompanying attestation that the data forwarded will not include personal data. The attached roster helps but we need a precise column mapping.
- Export controls / EU transfer: Routing stubbed through a US ingestion endpoint is a cross‑border transfer. For EU personal data that triggers our DPA Article 28+ transfers review and typically requires either Standard Contractual Clauses or an approved transfer mechanism. If the data is truly aggregated non‑personal metrics, we can document and treat it as non‑personal, but we need the dataflow diagram to be certain.
- Evidence: Please provide a cluster‑specific SOC2 + recent pen‑test summary OR a completed security questionnaire. We can accept a signed partial attestation for expedited windows but it must be tracked against OBS‑4821 in HubSpot and logged in our intake tracker.

Process: If Observify can: 1) provide the dataflow CSV mapping and 2) confirm no identifiers will be forwarded, we will attempt to approve a 72‑hour temporary onramp with the following controls:
  - IP allowlist + timebound token,
  - EU geo‑restriction toggle (we can pin to EU endpoints if trigger is set off),
  - Logging capture for later audit.

Alex, please upload the requested artifacts and confirm the exact fields by EOD. Irene — can you also prepare a one‑page DPA amendment template (scoped) we can send to Observify? Mark this as high priority in the intake tracker.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@observify.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Observify Security <security@observify.com>
Date: 2028-12-02T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: adding a telemetry hook (temporary) - need DPA/subprocessor note

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the clear checklist.

Attached is a one‑page dataflow CSV (fields: timestamp, metric_name, metric_value, customer_hash) — note we will hash customer ids on our side and will not send raw user_ids. Also attached: cluster SOC2 excerpt for the ingestion cluster and a brief pen test summary (redacted).

We are prepared to accept the scoped DPA amendment; please send the template and we'll sign immediately. For the demo we prefer the 72‑hour onramp; if you approve, we'll implement the IP allowlist and timebound token immediately and start the stream at 09:00 CET on Monday. If full approval can't be completed by then, we will gate to EU endpoints only.

Attachments: observify_subprocessor_deck.pdf (unchanged), subprocessor_roster_v1.csv (updated), observify_cluster_SOC2_excerpt.pdf

Best,
Alex Rivera
Partnerships / Observability
Observify
